title: 3D procedural island generator is live!!
author: deebs299
selftext:
You can try it now at [https://deebs299.github.io/Modular-Large-Scale-World/](https://deebs299.github.io/Modular-Large-Scale-World/)

Coded entirely with gemini in three.js. Let me know of any suggestions. I'm working on a fps mode rn but its a WIP. Refresh the tab to generate a new island!!!
